_comment: Per-stock signal configuration. Add a profile for any ticker to get custom thresholds and sell triggers. Stocks without profiles still get universal technical signals.

_instructions.adding_profiles: Copy an existing profile, change the ticker key, and customize the thresholds
_instructions.categories: chip_designer | chip_fabricator | server_infra | cloud_platform | ai_monetizer | connectivity | speculative | non_tech
_instructions.sector_signal_sensitivity: Lists which Layer 1 sector signals most affect this stock. Used to weight alerts.

NVDA.name: NVIDIA Corporation
NVDA.value_chain_position: GPU design — the tollbooth of AI compute. Gets paid first when capex goes up.

gross_margin_floor.description: Below 70% for 2 quarters signals pricing power erosion from custom silicon

revenue_growth_floor.description: Below 20% YoY means AI demand is decelerating

sell_triggers: Gross margins drop below 70% for two consecutive quarters
Hyperscaler capex guidance gets cut by any top-4 spender
A major hyperscaler moves >50% of AI training to custom chips
Rubin architecture delays pushing shipments past H2 2026
buy_signals: China export restrictions ease, reopening $10B+ TAM

AMD.name: Advanced Micro Devices
AMD.value_chain_position: CPU + GPU challenger. EPYC taking share from Intel, Instinct competing with NVIDIA.

dc_revenue_growth_floor.description: Data center revenue growth below 20% YoY = losing AI narrative

gross_margin_target.description: Margins need to expand toward 60% as GPU mix improves

forward_peg_ceiling.description: Above 1.5 = getting expensive for the growth rate

sell_triggers: Data center revenue growth decelerates below 20% YoY for two quarters
Gross margins fail to expand toward 60% as GPU mix increases
A major design win (OpenAI, Oracle) gets reversed or delayed
Forward PEG exceeds 2.0
buy_signals: MI350/MI400 benchmarks competitive with NVIDIA Rubin at lower price

INTC.name: Intel Corporation
INTC.value_chain_position: CPU manufacturer + foundry pivot. Domestic fab advantage in Hormuz era.

forward_pe_ceiling.description: Above 80x forward P/E without revenue acceleration = priced beyond reality

revenue_growth_floor.description: Continued revenue decline after stabilization = turnaround failing

sell_triggers: Intel 18A production yields fall below 50% (foundry thesis breaks)
Two consecutive quarters of revenue decline after current stabilization
CHIPS Act funding gets clawed back or delayed
Forward P/E exceeds 80x without revenue acceleration
buy_signals: First major foundry contract win (Qualcomm, NVIDIA, or Apple)
Revenue inflects to consistent growth with margins expanding
P/E compresses below 40x through earnings improvement

AMZN.name: Amazon.com
AMZN.value_chain_position: AWS cloud + retail + advertising. Only company monetizing AI infrastructure twice.

aws_growth_floor.description: AWS growth below 15% for 2 quarters = cloud share loss

fcf_floor.description: Negative FCF for >1 quarter = capex outrunning monetization

sell_triggers: AWS growth decelerates below 15% for two quarters
Free cash flow turns negative for more than one quarter
AI monetization rate fails to improve by end of 2026
buy_signals: AWS maintains 30%+ operating margins while growing 20%+
AI Bedrock becomes default enterprise AI platform

META.name: Meta Platforms
META.value_chain_position: AI-powered advertising platform. Clearest AI ROI story in big tech.

revenue_growth_floor.description: Revenue growth below 15% = ad market slowing or share loss

dau_decline_quarters.description: DAU decline for 2 quarters = engagement crisis

sell_triggers: Daily active users across family of apps decline for two consecutive quarters
Advantage+ AI revenue run rate plateaus or declines
Capex exceeds $150B without revenue acceleration
Advertising recession — broader economy weakens
buy_signals: Threads ad revenue materializes (400M+ users not yet monetized)

MSFT.name: Microsoft
MSFT.value_chain_position: Azure cloud + Copilot AI monetization. OpenAI partnership.

azure_growth_floor.description: Azure growth below 20% = losing cloud share

forward_peg_ceiling.description: Above 2.5 = overvalued for a mature grower

sell_triggers: Azure growth drops below 20% for two quarters
Copilot monetization significantly disappoints expectations
Forward P/E exceeds 40x without earnings acceleration
buy_signals: Copilot revenue becomes material ($10B+ run rate)

AAPL.name: Apple Inc.
AAPL.value_chain_position: Consumer ecosystem. On-device AI, services revenue growth.

services_growth_floor.description: Services growth below 10% = margin expansion story weakening

iphone_decline_quarters.description: iPhone units declining 3 quarters = hardware cycle problem

sell_triggers: Services revenue growth drops below 10%
iPhone unit sales decline for three consecutive quarters
China revenue declines accelerate due to geopolitical tensions
Forward P/E exceeds 35x without earnings acceleration
buy_signals: Apple Intelligence drives meaningful iPhone upgrade cycle
Services revenue exceeds $100B annual run rate

SMCI.name: Super Micro Computer
SMCI.value_chain_position: AI server assembly. Packages NVIDIA GPUs into rack-scale solutions.

gross_margin_floor.description: Gross margins below 12% = revenue growth is profitless

governance_flag.description: Any new SEC action, auditor issue, or criminal charge = exit

sell_triggers: Another governance scandal, SEC action, or criminal charge involving the company
Gross margins stay below 12% for two quarters
NVIDIA reduces allocation priority to SMCI
Insiders continue net selling
buy_signals: Several consecutive quarters of clean financial reporting
DLC market share gains vs Dell confirmed by third-party data

ASTS.name: AST SpaceMobile
ASTS.value_chain_position: Space-based cellular broadband. Pre-revenue but technology proven.

satellites_in_orbit_target.description: Fewer than 20 in orbit by end of 2026 = launch cadence failing

cash_runway_months.description: Less than 12 months runway = dilution risk

sell_triggers: Satellite launch cadence falls significantly behind plan
A major carrier partner exits their commercial agreement
Cash burn requires additional dilutive raises before breakeven
SpaceX announces direct-to-cell matching ASTS capabilities
buy_signals: First material revenue from partial service

BBAI.name: BigBear.ai
BBAI.value_chain_position: Government AI decision intelligence. Niche player competing with Palantir.

revenue_growth_floor.description: Revenue declining again = turnaround not working

ebitda_improving.description: EBITDA needs to trend toward breakeven

sell_triggers: Revenue guidance gets cut again
Major contract losses to Palantir
Cash burn accelerates requiring dilutive raises
EBITDA fails to improve toward breakeven by Q3 2026
buy_signals: Revenue growth exceeds 25% for a quarter

BIDU.name: Baidu Inc.
BIDU.value_chain_position: China AI leader. Ernie Bot LLM + Apollo Go autonomous driving.

search_share_floor.description: Search share below 50% = core business eroding

sell_triggers: US-China relations deteriorate further (new sanctions, forced delisting risk)
Chinese regulators impose restrictions on AI monetization
Search market share loss accelerates below 50%
Autonomous driving timeline slips beyond 2027
buy_signals: Apollo Go reaches profitability in any city

NOW.name: ServiceNow
NOW.value_chain_position: Enterprise AI workflow automation. AI agent platform.

subscription_growth_floor.description: Sub growth below 20% = enterprise AI demand slowing

sell_triggers: Subscription revenue growth drops below 20%
RPO (remaining performance obligations) growth decelerates
Forward P/E exceeds 70x without earnings acceleration
buy_signals: AI agent adoption drives RPO acceleration
Enterprise AI platform becomes industry standard

CRM.name: Salesforce

revenue_growth_floor.description: Revenue growth below 8% = maturing without AI uplift

sell_triggers: Revenue growth drops below 8%
Agentforce AI fails to show material revenue contribution
Operating margin compression

SOFI.name: SoFi Technologies

member_growth_floor.description: Member growth below 15% YoY = growth story fading

sell_triggers: Member growth decelerates below 15% YoY
Net interest margin compresses significantly
Credit quality deteriorates (rising delinquencies)

default_profile._comment: Applied to any ticker in portfolio.json that doesn't have a custom profile above

sector_signals._comment: Layer 1 signals that affect groups of stocks. Each stock profile references which of these it's sensitive to.

hyperscaler_capex.description: Aggregate capex guidance from MSFT, AMZN, GOOGL, META, ORCL

tsmc_revenue.description: TSMC monthly revenue — leading indicator of chip demand

helium_price.description: Helium spot price — Hormuz disruption proxy for chip manufacturing

cloud_growth.description: AWS + Azure quarterly revenue growth rates

oil_price.description: Brent crude — energy cost proxy for data centers

china_pmi.description: China PMI — demand proxy for China-exposed stocks

treasury_10y.description: 10Y Treasury yield — higher = lower growth multiples

dxy.description: US Dollar Index — strong dollar hurts overseas earners
